subject: Aligning infra owners + slot for technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Chloë Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karen Li <karen.li@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning infra owners + slot for technical deep-dive

Hi Chloë / Aditya —

Thanks again for the call today. We covered a lot and the Sunrise Eng leadership is keen to move to a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive next week to validate latency, token-cost assumptions, and the rollout pattern.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm which of your engineers would lead the infra discussion? We want to make sure our SRE and ML infra leads (me + Karen) have the right contacts.
- Please share 3x candidate slots (60–90 min) next week that include some overlap with US Eastern hours (we are East coast heavy).
- If possible, attach an agenda so we can route prep/questions internally.

We are thinking scope: production latency targets, KV cache behavior for long-context prompts, and deployment options (Dedicated vs Private).

I attached a short list of our top questions (see attachment: proposed_agenda.pdf). We can be flexible on timing; ideal for us is Tue/Wed afternoon ET.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Amit Shah
Director of Platform Engineering
Sunrise Health

Attachments: proposed_agenda.pdf
From: Chloë Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning infra owners + slot for technical deep-dive

Hi Amit —

Thanks for the clear recap and the agenda — great starting point. Happy to take point on scheduling. For the deep-dive, our recommended attendees are:
- Aditya Rao (Sales Engineer) — overall demo and model routing policy
- Dev Patel (Senior Infrastructure Engineer) — serving runtime, KV/cache, and autoscaling behavior
- Laura Bennett (Customer Solutions) — rollout and SLOs + support questions (I will include her if we get to rollout specifics)

Candidate slots (all shown in ET):
- Tue Jun 1: 2:00pm–3:30pm ET
- Wed Jun 2: 11:00am–12:30pm ET (Dev has a hard break at 12:30)
- Wed Jun 2: 3:00pm–4:30pm ET

If none of those work, we can extend to Thu Jun 3 afternoon. I also put together a 1-page proposed agenda and a lightweight SOW stub for pre-read (see SOW-draft.docx attached).

Proposed agenda (short):
1) 5m intros + success criteria
2) 20m infra overview + runtime optimizations (Dev)
3) 25m latency/cost modeling + KV cache examples (Aditya)
4) 20m deployment options & rollout pattern (Chloë/Laura)
5) 10m Q&A + next steps

Next steps for you: confirm which of these slots works for the core Sunrise attendees and give any additions to the agenda. I will send calendar invites once you confirm.

Cheers,
Chloë Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOW-draft.docx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@sunrisehealth.com>, Chloë Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning infra owners + slot for technical deep-dive

Hi Amit / Chloë —

Thanks — I can lead the latency and cost modeling portion, and Dev will cover runtime internals. A couple of notes from our side to help prep so the session is high signal:
- Please share an example prompt type and an expected p99 latency SLO for a 1k-token response (this will let us show concrete numbers).
- If you have traffic shape (requests per minute and batch sizes) that would be helpful for batching + KV cache examples.
- Any compliance or VPC requirements we should call out up front? Laura and I can cover Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs briefly.

Slot preference: Wed Jun 2, 11:00am–12:30pm ET works best for Dev and me. If that works for your team, Chloë, feel free to lock the invite.

Small ask — can we include Karen Li and one engineer from your SRE team on the invite? If Karen prefers, we can also record the session.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Chloë Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karen Li <karen.li@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning infra owners + slot for technical deep-dive

Chloë / Aditya —

Wed Jun 2, 11:00am–12:30pm ET works for our core group. I added Karen and will invite Miguel (our SRE lead) as well. I attached a calendar invite stub and confirmed the pre-read (proposed_agenda.pdf) has been routed to our infra team.

Two quick clarifications:
- SLO: target p99 around 800ms for 1k-token responses in steady-state, with occasional spikes allowed during batch async windows.
- Traffic shape: we are currently prototyping ~25 req/min average with ~3–5 reqs burst capacity; we will share a slightly more detailed traffic CSV in a follow-up.

Please send the calendar invite and any dial-in/recording details. Looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Amit Shah
Director of Platform Engineering
Sunrise Health

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics (stub)
